scope: Audit of recoverable compound-number mappings between the accepted primary article Table 1 and exact CHEMBL4328667 ROCK2 records. Unmapped rows are explicitly not claimed inconsistent.

sources.citation: Hobson et al., J Med Chem 2018, DOI 10.1021/acs.jmedchem.8b01098, accepted manuscript pp.5-7
ACS Supporting Information, HTRF assay and ROCK2 crystallization protocol, pp.S2-S3 and S16

assay_confirmation.table_endpoint: Table 1 labels columns IC50 / µM at 100 µM ATP for ROCK1, ROCK2 and PKA (article pp.6-7).
assay_confirmation.SI_protocol: SI HTRF protocol sets final ATP 100 µM, STK S2 peptide 0.2 µM, ROCK2 enzyme 0.5 nM, 60 min reaction at room temperature, then 1 h-to-overnight detection and EnVision readout (SI pp.S2-S3). This resolves the apparent ChEMBL wording: the assay is HTRF fluorescence readout after a 33P-ATP statement in the article HTS description; the SI protocol itself specifies HTRF reagents/readout and 100 µM ATP.
assay_confirmation.structure_construct: SI p.S16 specifies human ROCK2 residues 27-417 with N-terminal 6His/TEV tag for compound-12 crystallization. This is distinct from the CHEMBL4328667 assay description (residues 11-552), and also explains why the 6ED6 polymer sequence is 415 residues after tag/processing context.

mapping_count.interpretation: The 32 unmapped records may correspond to later article tables or compounds whose numbers are not retained in the ChEMBL JSON; they are not called mismatches.

table1_mappings.match_basis: unsubstituted aryl structure and Table 1 value
benzodioxolane structure; exact PDB 6ED6/J0P ligand identity; Table 1 anchor
dimethylamino substituent structure and Table 1 value
morpholine substituent structure and Table 1 value

inconsistencies_or_data_hygiene.value_consistency: All 11 high-confidence Table 1 mappings agree numerically after µM-to-nM conversion; no clear compound-number/value inconsistency was found in this subset.
inconsistencies_or_data_hygiene.duplicate: No duplicate molecule record was found within CHEMBL4328667 among the 45 assay records. Molecule CHEMBL4448806 appears in two different assays: activity 18939235 is CHEMBL4328667, IC50 2 nM; activity 18939460 is CHEMBL4328710, IC50 1 nM. These must not be merged as replicate measurements.
inconsistencies_or_data_hygiene.non_ic50: The 46 downloaded records include 45 records for CHEMBL4328667 (44 IC50 plus one text-only Inhibition=Active, activity 18939223) and one IC50 record from a different assay CHEMBL4328710 (activity 18939460). The latter is excluded from this assay panel.
inconsistencies_or_data_hygiene.censoring: CHEMBL4540054 is a right-censored >10,000 nM record; retaining it as an inequality is correct and treating it as exactly 10,000 nM would be inconsistent with the article.

benchmark_implication: The 43-compound exact-unique panel is suitable for a retrospective same-assay ROCK2 analysis, with 11 independently audited Table 1 mappings and 32 records left without compound-number claims. Use source activity IDs and canonical structures for identity, preserve nM/µM provenance and inequalities, and avoid describing the whole panel as independently verified against every numbered article table.
decision: No clear inconsistency was found among the 11 recoverable Table 1 mappings. Compound 12/ CHEMBL4522042 / PDB 6ED6 is a secure measured anchor, while the assay (11-552) and structure crystallization (27-417) constructs remain distinct and must be reported as such.
